    Estimate adult mortality with two survey/census observations from orphanhood data.

    orphanhood_two.Rd

    Estimates adult mortality from orphanhood in two observations using Timaeus, Preston-Chen, or the Masquelier-Timaeus HIV adaptation.

    orphanhood_two(
  prop1_not_orphan,
  prop2_not_orphan,
  age1,
  age2,
  date1,
  date2,
  maternal = TRUE,
  method = "timæus",
  mac1 = NULL,
  mac2 = NULL,
  mlt_data_input = NULL,
  mlt_family = NULL,
  brass_logit = FALSE,
  brass_logit_e0 = 60,
  HIV_prev = NULL,
  HIV_art = NULL,
  HIV_pmtct = NULL,
  HIV_5q0 = NULL,
  HIV_period_covariates = c("midpoint", "average"),
  HIV_age_above30 = c("identity_if_low_exposure", "drop", "identity"),
  HIV_birth_exposure_tol = 0.001,
  e0_accept = c(20, 100),
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    prop1_not_orphan

    numeric vector. Population proportion of respondents with mother/father alive, by age groups, from source 1.

    prop2_not_orphan

    numeric vector. Population proportion of respondents with mother/father alive, by age groups, from source 2.

    age1

    integer vector. Lower bound of age groups from first census.

    age2

    Same than age1 but for the second source.

    date1

    Either a Date class object or an unambiguous character string in the format "YYYY-MM-DD". Reference date for source 1.

    date2

    Same than date1 but for the second source.

    maternal

    logical. Either TRUE for maternal orphanhood (default) or FALSE for paternal orphanhood.

    method

    character. One of timÃ¦us (default), preston_chen, or masquellier_timÃ¦us.

    mac1

    numeric. Mean age at childbearing for mothers/fathers from source 1.

    mac2

    Same than mac1 but for the second source.

    mlt_data_input

    data.frame. Optional model life table input; use with brass_logit = TRUE.

    mlt_family

    character. Model life table family. If NULL, returns all CD and UN families.

    brass_logit

    logical. Doing a level smoothing with 1-parameter logit Brass.

    brass_logit_e0

    numeric. Life expectancy at birth when brass_logit is TRUE.

    HIV_prev, HIV_art, HIV_5q0

    numeric or data.frame. HIV prevalence, ART coverage, and 5q0 inputs used by HIV variants.

    HIV_pmtct

    numeric or data.frame. PMTCT coverage for method = masquellier_timÃ¦us.

    HIV_period_covariates

    character. Use midpoint or average HIV/ART period covariates in the Masquelier-Timaeus equations.

    HIV_age_above30

    character. How to handle ages above Table 2 adjustment coefficients in the Masquelier-Timaeus method.

    HIV_birth_exposure_tol

    numeric. Tolerance used when deciding whether HIV birth exposure is negligible.

    e0_accept

    integer vector. Range acceptable when calculating the median of implied level by age.
